changes.title: Champion tuned
items: The champion bot plays with the numbers its overnight search found: it lasts longer than the skilled bot on maps it never trained on

changes.title: Burrower shapes
items: Hedgehogs bristle with long spines past their outline
Toads sit squat and wide, their eyes standing up like domes
Moles are long and low, with a long snout and huge spade hands

changes.title: Perf panel
items: ?perf=1 shows a small performance panel: frame times, hitches, what each part of the frame costs, memory and the crowd
